notes.animlab.title: The lab's title: a tool that plays every animation of the engine's characters.
notes.animlab.hud.skin: The skin (character type) shown, between arrows: left and right change it.
notes.animlab.hud.lineup: Every skin side by side; {count} is how many (11).
notes.animlab.hud.time: The timeline: {phase} is the phase playing now (a line of its own, or nothing), {t} the time into the animation and {len} its length, in seconds (s).
notes.animlab.cam.view: Camera info, small: {view} is the camera view's name (Side, Iso...).
notes.animlab.cam.turn: Camera info: the camera turned {angle} degrees (deg).
notes.animlab.cam.slow: Camera info: playing at a quarter of full speed (.25 times).
notes.animlab.cam.speed: Camera info: playing at full speed (1 times).
notes.animlab.seg: A combo's phase on the timeline: {move} the move's name, {phase} its phase (WIND, HIT, RECOVER), e.g. JAB WIND.
notes.animlab.legend.animation: A key hint: {key:up}{key:down} are the keys (the arrows up and down) that pick the animation.
notes.animlab.legend.skin: A key hint: the keys (left and right arrows) that change the skin.
notes.animlab.legend.view: A key hint: V is the key that changes the camera view; keep it.
notes.animlab.legend.zoom: A key hint: - and = are the keys that zoom; keep them.
notes.animlab.legend.turn: A key hint: [ and ] are the keys that turn the camera; keep them.
notes.animlab.legend.reset: A key hint: 0 is the key that resets the camera; keep it.
notes.animlab.legend.flip: A key hint: the key that turns the characters round.
notes.animlab.legend.pause: A key hint: the key (Space) that pauses.
notes.animlab.legend.step: A key hint: the key (.) that steps one frame while paused.
notes.animlab.legend.slow: A key hint: the key that plays at quarter speed.
notes.animlab.legend.trail: A key hint: the key that shows or hides the weapon trail.
notes.animlab.legend.bones: A key hint: the key that shows the skeleton.
notes.animlab.legend.lineup: A key hint: the key that lines every skin up.
notes.animlab.legend.replay: A key hint: the key that replays the animation.
notes.animlab.legend.hud: A key hint: the key that hides this display (HUD: heads-up display).
notes.animlab.legend.touch_pick: On a phone: the stick up and down picks the animation, left and right the skin.
notes.animlab.legend.touch_buttons: On a phone: the names of its three touch buttons.
notes.animlab.note.turn: A notice: the camera turned to {angle} degrees (DEG: the pixel font has no degree sign).
notes.animlab.note.bones_on: A notice: the skeleton (the rig's bones) is drawn.
notes.animlab.note.one: A notice: back to one skin from the lineup.
notes.animlab.group.magic_more: A group of animations: casting, throwing and the rest.
notes.animlab.group.more: A group for moves added later.
notes.animlab.anim.jump_air: An animation: a jump, through the air.
notes.animlab.anim.hips: A pose: hands on the hips.
notes.animlab.move.flyingkick: A flying kick (one word, as the engine names it).
notes.animlab.move.axekick: An axe kick (one word, as the engine names it).
notes.animlab.phase.wind: A move's wind-up, before the blow lands.
notes.animlab.phase.hit: The moment a move strikes; also being hit.
notes.animlab.phase.recover: A move's return to guard, after the blow.
notes.animlab.phase.follow: A move's follow-through, after the blow.
notes.animlab.phase.down: Climbing down a ladder, or lying knocked down.
notes.animlab.skin.rabite: A rabbit-like blob creature: a made-up name.
notes.action.hold: Pauses the animation: an action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.

brief: The animation lab: a tool, not a game. It plays every animation the engine's characters can do (walking, sword and fist moves, kicks, poses, reactions) on every skin (a character type: knight, mage, slime...) from every camera view, with a timeline of each move's phases. Its words are short technical labels, mostly in capitals, in narrow lists: keep them as short as the English. WIND is a move's wind-up, HIT the moment it strikes, RECOVER its return to guard.
